title: Modium Pro
description: Modium Pro expands Modium with advanced tools for building, automation, and content creation, ideal for experienced players
body:
# Modium Pro

> *All the comfort of Modium, powered up for pros*
> 
Modium Pro is the advanced version of Modium, designed for experienced players who want more than just performance and comfort. It includes everything from the base Modium pack, plus a set of powerful tools for building, recording, automation, and technical gameplay.

## Who is it for?
Advanced players looking for the ultimate modpack with optimization, enhanced gameplay, and professional tools for creation and precision.

## Features
- Optimization
- Optifine-compatible resource packs
- Extended render distance
- Shader support (Complementary Shaders)
- Quality of life improvements
- Enhanced textures
- Better sounds
- Voice chat
- Building tools
- Utility tools
- Recording and replay features
- Advanced debug

**Optimization**: Tweaks and performance mods that make Minecraft run faster and smoother, without altering visuals or gameplay in any way

**Far View**: See terrain far beyond the vanilla render distance, with better performance thanks to simplified detail, and full support for multiplayer and shaders

**Quality of Life**: Adds small, non-intrusive features that enhance comfort, usability, and gameplay flow while preserving the vanilla experience

**Advanced Tools**: Includes creative and technical tools for experienced players such as builders, mapmakers, content creators, and redstone engineers
